sessions.intent: Lower - W1D2. Teneriffe Athletic Club Strength, 2026-09-17. Pulled from TrainHeroic.

slots.name: Calf Stretch + Toe Lift in Rack
slots.note: The warm up will typically be 2-3 rounds of these exercises based on a time cap. Complete as many rounds as you can in the given warm up time · This is a contract / relax exercise - Spend 10seconds in as deep of a stretch as possible with your heel nice and close to the rack. The next 10 seconds will be spent pulling your toes back towards you

slots.name: Quadruped Hip CARS
slots.note: Trying to move just from your hip and not your lower back. Go through the biggest amount of range of motion you can through your hips · 3 reps in each direction per side

slots.name: DB Goblet Squat
slots.note: Slow and controlled. Choose a weight that is roughly 20-30% of what your working weight will be on your main sets

slots.name: Squat Jumps
slots.note: Doesn't have to be max effort but intended to get the joints moving dynamically. Try to be nice and smooth through these for the prescribed time

slots.name: Barbell Back Squat
slots.note: Back Squats will follow a 9/7/5 wave loading progression in 3 week cycles. Week one 9s, week two 7s, week three 5s. Each wave we will add more weight on from what we did last time · Please complete any neccessary warm up sets. Only working sets count as actual sets · If you prefer Front Squats they will be a suggested swap below.

slots.name: Depth Jump
slots.note: Jumping off a box or bench. This can be done with or without arms.

slots.name: Barbell FFE Jefferson Split Squat
slots.note: 2RIR (2 reps in reserve). This should still feel very challenging if you have a good awareness of how hard you can push yourself. · Keep a vertical torso · Tempo 2.2.2

slots.name: Single Leg Hamstring Bridge (Off Bench)
slots.note: Add weight if the prescribed rep range is too easy · Key cues are to think about pulling your heel back towards you as the way to extend your hip. Your aiming to have your torso inline with your leg at the top. · Think about exhaling as you come up and inhaling as you lower with control on the way back down

slots.name: DB Cyclist Squats (1 & 1/4)
slots.note: Quad finisher to end the session. · Ideally set this up with a plate next to the end of the platform so you can get enough heel elevation - this will help bias more quads as you will be able to keep an upright torso. · If you feel your knees on this please complete one of the suggested swaps.

slots.name: Reverse Copenhagen Plank
slots.note: Do the prescribed time on both side. Try to keep in a dead straight line. If the 30seconds is quite easy, please add a weight plate between your thighs. · Time will increase each week

slots.name: Single Leg Calf Raises (Weighted)
slots.note: Choose a weight that is challenging to get 8 reps. Please elevate your feet on a plate and go through the full range of motion. · The bottom range of motion is the most important

sessions.intent: Upper - W1D1. Teneriffe Athletic Club Strength, 2026-09-15. Pulled from TrainHeroic.

slots.name: Banded Lat Activation
slots.note: The warm up will typically be 2-3 rounds of these exercises based on a warm up time cap. Complete as many rounds as you can in the given warm up time

slots.name: Hanging Scap Retracts
slots.note: Really think about bringing your arm pit towards the ground. Hold for a second on each rep · Your elbows should stay straight

slots.name: Medball Thoracic Opener
slots.note: Set the medball as close to your hips as possible. Hold the plate in both hands and reach back towards the ground. Actively think about inhaling to your chest as you reach back. · Feel free to use a lighter weight or dumbbells if the 5kg plate feels too hard. Each rep should get progressively easier and you should be able to reach closer and closer to the ground.

slots.name: Push Up To Downward Dog
slots.note: Push up first and then think about pushing the floor away and making your spine as long as possible

slots.name: Weighted Chin Up
slots.note: Choose a weight that you can get to 5 reps with 2RIR (Two reps in reserve). It is important not to overshoot on your weight in week one of the program. · First three weeks is building volume so there will be one extra set per week

slots.name: Prone Weighted Angels
slots.note: Think about making the biggest circumference. · If you can do 3 sets of 15 at a weight - go up next week and start back at 10 reps. · You typically won't need a very heavy weight for this. Make use of the variety of different size plates TAC has to offer.

slots.name: Tempo Barbell Bench Press
slots.note: Tempo 4.1.1 (4second negatives) · Reach your chest towards the bar as you come down · 2RIR (2 reps in reserve)

slots.name: KB Gorilla Row
slots.note: Alternating arms - Push firmly into one kettlebell and row with the opposite. Think about leading with your elbow. · If the specific KB weights don't quite match your strength level, then please complete a single arm DB row in the suggested swaps. · This should feel challenging by the last rep

slots.name: Tricep Push Up
slots.note: 1RIR (One rep in reserve) · If you get above 15 please add a plate to your back

slots.name: DB Rear Delt Fly
slots.note: 1RIR (One rep in reserve) · Bentover - Lead with your elbows not your hands

slots.name: Oblique Crunch
slots.note: Do the prescribed reps on each side. Exhale as you crunch

sessions.intent: Full Body - W1D3. Teneriffe Athletic Club Strength, 2026-09-19. Pulled from TrainHeroic.

slots.name: Quadruped Glute Stretch
slots.note: The warm up will typically be 2-3 rounds of these exercises based on a time cap. Complete as many rounds as you can in the given warm up time

slots.name: Adductor Rock Back Stretch
slots.note: Roll your foot to the outside and try to maintain anterior tilt throughout (tailbone facing the roof).

slots.name: Glute Bridge w/Rotation
slots.note: Do the prescribed reps on each side

slots.name: Single Leg Arabesque
slots.note: Do the prescribed reps on each side. · Slight bend in your knee. Imagine you are a see saw and your torso and back leg moves as one. · You may do this with weight as well

slots.name: Barbell RDL
slots.note: E3OM (Every 3 minutes on the minute) · Following the same progression as Back Squats - a 9/7/5 wave loading progression in 3 week cycles. Week one 9s, week two 7s, week three 5s. Each wave we will add more weight on from what we did last time · If you are unsure on your weight then please choose a weight where you will have 2RIR (2 reps in reserve).

slots.name: Cossack Squat
slots.note: Do the presribed reps on each side. · Think about shifting your weight onto your working leg. It's equally important to both draw back into your hip and drive your knee forward. · Choose a weight where you have 2RIR (2 reps in reserve)

slots.name: Barbell Z-Press
slots.note: Choose a weight that leaves you with 2RIR when you get to 8 reps (2 reps in reserve) · If you lack the mobility for this - please sit on a 20 or 25kg plate. If you lack the upper body mobility - please do a DB Z-Press which is in the suggested swaps.

slots.name: Inverted Rows (Feet Elevated)
slots.note: Glutes/hips stay engaged. Drive your elbows to the ground and aim to hit your sternum on the bar

slots.name: Barbell Bicep Curl
slots.note: High rep finisher - Choose a weight you can just get 12 reps with · Isolation exercises you don't need to typically worry about reps in reserve. Since they are such small muscle groups you can typically go really close to failure

slots.name: DB Skullcrusher
slots.note: Isolation exercises you don't need to typically worry about reps in reserve. Since they are such small muscle groups you can typically go really close to failure

slots.name: Double Leg Lowers
slots.note: Draw belly button to the ground, keep knees bent and think about an arcing motion on the way back up · Do this off a bench or box if this is too easy

slots.name: Quadruped Glute Stretch
slots.note: The warm up will typically be 2-3 rounds of these exercises based on a time cap. Complete as many rounds as you can in the given warm up time

slots.name: Adductor Rock Back Stretch
slots.note: Roll your foot to the outside and try to maintain anterior tilt throughout (tailbone facing the roof).

slots.name: Glute Bridge w/Rotation
slots.note: Do the prescribed reps on each side

slots.name: Single Leg Arabesque
slots.note: Do the prescribed reps on each side. · Slight bend in your knee. Imagine you are a see saw and your torso and back leg moves as one.

slots.name: Barbell RDL
slots.note: E3OM (Every 3 minutes on the minute) · Following the same progression as Back Squats - a 9/7/5 wave loading progression in 3 week cycles. Week one 9s, week two 7s, week three 5s. Each wave we will add more weight on from what we did last time · If you are unsure on your weight then please choose a weight where you will have 2RIR (2 reps in reserve).

slots.name: Cossack Squat
slots.note: Do the presribed reps on each side. · Think about shifting your weight onto your working leg. It's equally important to both draw back into your hip and drive your knee forward. · Choose a weight where you have 2RIR (2 reps in reserve)

slots.name: Barbell Z-Press
slots.note: Choose a weight that leaves you with 2RIR when you get to 8 reps (2 reps in reserve) · If you lack the mobility for this - please sit on a 20 or 25kg plate. If you lack the upper body mobility - please do a DB Z-Press which is in the suggested swaps.

slots.name: Inverted Rows (Feet Elevated)
slots.note: Glutes/hips stay engaged. Drive your elbows to the ground and aim to hit your sternum on the bar

slots.name: Barbell Bicep Curl
slots.note: High rep finisher - Choose a weight you can just get 15 reps with · Isolation exercises you don't need to typically worry about reps in reserve. Since they are such small muscle groups you can typically go really close to failure

slots.name: DB Skullcrusher
slots.note: Isolation exercises you don't need to typically worry about reps in reserve. Since they are such small muscle groups you can typically go really close to failure

slots.name: Double Leg Lowers
slots.note: Draw belly button to the ground, keep knees bent and think about an arcing motion on the way back up · Do this off a bench or box if this is too easy
